acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury property sales representatives utilize exclusive marketing strategies tailored to affluent buyers, going beyond standard MLS listings. Kelby Contreras leverages a network of high-net-worth individuals and international buyers, ensuring your property gains exposure to the most qualified prospects in areas like Brickell and Fort Lauderdale Beach.
